en.name: Witcher
en.ability: Once per game, during the night*, you may choose a player: they die, and the demon cannot attack that night. If you kill the demon, you and them swap roles and teams.

revisions.v1: Once per game, during the night*, you may choose a player: they die, and the demon cannot attack that night. If you kill the demon, you and them swap roles and teams.

en.otherNightReminder: Wake them up and have them choose a player, marking the chosen player with a 'dead' reminder token.

zh.name: 猎魔人
zh.ability: 每局游戏限一次，在夜晚时*，你可以选择一名玩家：他死亡，且当晚恶魔不能攻击。如果你杀死了恶魔，你和他交换角色和阵营。
